a.text: Hi partner. I plan to stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. One concern: there is an 80% storm chance after every round, so reaching 8 (two operate rounds) means we probably both get caught short. If you want to renegotiate openly, say so and propose something. Until we both agree on a change, I'll keep my word and operate.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
